'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a quest-exclusive [[NPC]] that first appears with '''[[Zihan]]''' in {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}. 
__NOTOC__
{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Muxuan:''' With everything that's happened lately, why hasn't Paragon Qingxiao shown herself yet?
:''Zihan:''' Strange, right? I even raised it with the Ministry of War. I got a lot of hemming and hawing, but no straight answers.

==Dialogue==
;During {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}
:'''Muxuan:''' With everything that's happened lately, why hasn't Paragon Qingxiao shown herself yet?
:''Zihan:''' Strange, right? I even raised it with the Ministry of War. I got a lot of hemming and hawing, but no straight answers.
:'''Muxuan:''' Every other time the Land of Xuanfang was in need, Qingxiao the Perfected would descend from the mountain. But this time... could something have happened...?
{{Dialogue End}}
